meanings.en: a compact disc that stores computer data which can only be read
meanings.exampleEn: The software came on a CD-ROM that I installed on my old computer.
meanings.exampleTr: Yazılım, eski bilgisayarıma kurduğum bir CD-ROM ile geldi.

meanings.en: a famous person, especially in entertainment or sport
meanings.exampleEn: The young singer became a celebrity almost overnight.
meanings.exampleTr: Genç şarkıcı neredeyse bir gecede ünlü biri oldu.

meanings.en: the smallest basic unit of a living organism
meanings.exampleEn: The human body is made up of millions of tiny cells.
meanings.exampleTr: İnsan vücudu milyonlarca küçük hücreden oluşur.

meanings.en: in or near the centre of something; most important
meanings.exampleEn: They live in a central area, close to all the shops.
meanings.exampleTr: Tüm dükkânlara yakın, merkezi bir bölgede yaşıyorlar.

meanings.en: a system that heats a building from one source through pipes or vents
meanings.exampleEn: We turned on the central heating because the house was freezing.
meanings.exampleTr: Ev buz gibi olduğu için merkezi ısıtmayı açtık.

meanings.en: a formal event performed on an important occasion
meanings.exampleEn: The wedding ceremony took place in a small village church.
meanings.exampleTr: Düğün töreni küçük bir köy kilisesinde gerçekleşti.

meanings.en: the state of being completely sure about something
meanings.exampleEn: I cannot say with any certainty when he will arrive.
meanings.exampleTr: Onun ne zaman geleceğini herhangi bir kesinlikle söyleyemem.

meanings.en: difficult in an interesting way that tests your abilities
meanings.exampleEn: Learning a new language can be challenging but rewarding.
meanings.exampleTr: Yeni bir dil öğrenmek zorlayıcı ama ödüllendirici olabilir.

meanings.en: a person or team that wins a competition
meanings.exampleEn: She became the world champion after winning the final match.
meanings.exampleTr: Final maçını kazandıktan sonra dünya şampiyonu oldu.

meanings.en: a television or radio station; a path for water or information
meanings.exampleEn: He switched to a different channel to watch the news.
meanings.exampleTr: Haberleri izlemek için başka bir kanala geçti.

meanings.en: a state of complete confusion and disorder
meanings.exampleEn: The sudden storm caused chaos at the airport.
meanings.exampleTr: Ani fırtına havalimanında kaosa yol açtı.

meanings.en: to be typical of something or to describe its qualities
meanings.exampleEn: Heavy rain and strong winds characterize the autumn season here.
meanings.exampleTr: Şiddetli yağmur ve güçlü rüzgârlar buradaki sonbahar mevsimini karakterize eder.

meanings.en: the amount of money you must pay for something
meanings.exampleEn: There is no charge for using the hotel swimming pool.
meanings.exampleTr: Otel yüzme havuzunu kullanmak için bir ücret yoktur.

meanings.en: a two-wheeled vehicle pulled by horses, used in ancient times
meanings.exampleEn: The Roman soldier drove his chariot into the battle.
meanings.exampleTr: Romalı asker savaş arabasını muharebeye sürdü.

meanings.en: an organization that helps people in need
meanings.exampleEn: She donated some money to a charity for homeless children.
meanings.exampleTr: Evsiz çocuklar için bir hayır kurumuna biraz para bağışladı.

meanings.en: the quality of being attractive and pleasant
meanings.exampleEn: The old town has a special charm that visitors love.
meanings.exampleTr: Eski kasabanın ziyaretçilerin sevdiği özel bir cazibesi var.

meanings.en: an act of following something quickly in order to catch it
meanings.exampleEn: The police car chase lasted for several minutes.
meanings.exampleTr: Polisin kovalaması birkaç dakika sürdü.

meanings.en: a friendly and informal conversation
meanings.exampleEn: We had a nice chat over a cup of coffee.
meanings.exampleTr: Bir fincan kahve eşliğinde güzel bir sohbet ettik.

meanings.en: a TV or radio programme where a host interviews guests
meanings.exampleEn: The actor talked about his new film on a popular chat show.
meanings.exampleTr: Oyuncu, popüler bir söyleşi programında yeni filmi hakkında konuştu.

meanings.en: a desk at an airport where you register before a flight
meanings.exampleEn: We waited in line at the check-in counter to drop off our bags.
meanings.exampleTr: Bagajlarımızı bırakmak için check-in bankosunda sırada bekledik.

meanings.en: a place at an airport or hotel where you register on arrival
meanings.exampleEn: Please show your passport at the check-in desk.
meanings.exampleTr: Lütfen pasaportunuzu check-in masasında gösterin.

meanings.en: the place in a shop where you pay for goods
meanings.exampleEn: There was a long queue at the supermarket checkout.
meanings.exampleTr: Süpermarket kasasında uzun bir kuyruk vardı.

meanings.en: happy and showing a positive attitude
meanings.exampleEn: She gave us a cheerful smile when we arrived.
meanings.exampleTr: Geldiğimizde bize neşeli bir gülümseme verdi.

meanings.en: a person who prepares medicines, or a scientist studying chemistry
meanings.exampleEn: The chemist gave me some tablets for my headache.
meanings.exampleTr: Eczacı bana baş ağrım için birkaç hap verdi.

meanings.en: the science that studies substances and how they react
meanings.exampleEn: My favourite subject at school was chemistry.
meanings.exampleTr: Okuldaki en sevdiğim ders kimyaydı.

meanings.en: to love and care for something deeply
meanings.exampleEn: I will always cherish the memories of our trip together.
meanings.exampleTr: Birlikte yaptığımız gezinin anılarına her zaman değer vereceğim.

meanings.en: a piece of furniture with drawers for storing clothes
meanings.exampleEn: She keeps her socks in the top drawer of the chest of drawers.
meanings.exampleTr: Çoraplarını şifonyerin en üst çekmecesinde tutar.

meanings.en: a sweet substance that you chew but do not swallow
meanings.exampleEn: He offered me a piece of chewing gum after lunch.
meanings.exampleTr: Öğle yemeğinden sonra bana bir sakız ikram etti.

meanings.en: most important or highest in rank
meanings.exampleEn: The chief reason for his success was hard work.
meanings.exampleTr: Başarısının başlıca nedeni sıkı çalışmaydı.

meanings.en: a group of people who sing together
meanings.exampleEn: She sings in the church choir every Sunday.
meanings.exampleTr: Her pazar kilise korosunda şarkı söyler.

meanings.en: to be unable to breathe because something blocks your throat
meanings.exampleEn: He began to choke on a small piece of bone.
meanings.exampleTr: Küçük bir kemik parçasıyla boğulmaya başladı.

meanings.en: relating to the religion based on the teachings of Jesus Christ
meanings.exampleEn: They were married in a traditional Christian ceremony.
meanings.exampleTr: Geleneksel bir Hristiyan töreniyle evlendiler.

meanings.en: arranged in the order in which events happened
meanings.exampleEn: The book lists the events in chronological order.
meanings.exampleTr: Kitap olayları kronolojik sırayla listeler.

meanings.en: a quiet or gentle laugh
meanings.exampleEn: He gave a soft chuckle at the funny joke.
meanings.exampleTr: Komik şakaya hafifçe kıkırdadı.

meanings.en: shaped like a circle or moving in a circle
meanings.exampleEn: They sat around a large circular table.
meanings.exampleTr: Büyük dairesel bir masanın etrafında oturdular.

meanings.en: a travelling show with performers, clowns and animals
meanings.exampleEn: The children laughed at the clowns at the circus.
meanings.exampleTr: Çocuklar sirkteki palyaçolara güldüler.

meanings.en: the legal right to belong to a particular country
meanings.exampleEn: After living there for years, she applied for citizenship.
meanings.exampleTr: Orada yıllarca yaşadıktan sonra vatandaşlık için başvurdu.

meanings.en: relating to ordinary citizens and their affairs
meanings.exampleEn: Voting is an important civil right in a democracy.
meanings.exampleTr: Oy vermek demokraside önemli bir sivil haktır.

meanings.en: a society with a highly developed culture and organization
meanings.exampleEn: Ancient Egyptian civilization built the great pyramids.
meanings.exampleTr: Antik Mısır uygarlığı büyük piramitleri inşa etti.

meanings.en: a statement that something is true, often without proof
meanings.exampleEn: There is no evidence to support his claim.
meanings.exampleTr: İddiasını destekleyecek hiçbir kanıt yok.

meanings.en: traditional in style and considered to be of high quality
meanings.exampleEn: She enjoys listening to classical music in the evening.
meanings.exampleTr: Akşamları klasik müzik dinlemekten hoşlanır.

meanings.en: to arrange things into groups by their type or features
meanings.exampleEn: Scientists classify animals into different groups.
meanings.exampleTr: Bilim insanları hayvanları farklı gruplara sınıflandırır.

meanings.en: a short sharp sound, or the act of pressing a mouse button
meanings.exampleEn: With a single click, you can open the program.
meanings.exampleTr: Tek bir tıklamayla programı açabilirsin.

meanings.en: a high steep area of rock, often by the sea
meanings.exampleEn: They stood on the cliff and looked at the sea below.
meanings.exampleTr: Uçurumun üzerinde durup aşağıdaki denize baktılar.

meanings.en: the typical weather conditions of an area over a long time
meanings.exampleEn: The country has a warm and dry climate.
meanings.exampleTr: Ülkenin sıcak ve kuru bir iklimi var.

meanings.en: a person who climbs mountains or rocks as a sport
meanings.exampleEn: The climber reached the top of the mountain at sunrise.
meanings.exampleTr: Dağcı, gün doğarken dağın zirvesine ulaştı.

meanings.en: a place where people go for medical treatment or advice
meanings.exampleEn: She took her sick child to the local clinic.
meanings.exampleTr: Hasta çocuğunu yerel kliniğe götürdü.

meanings.en: a short part of a film or video; a small fastener
meanings.exampleEn: They showed a short clip from the new movie.
meanings.exampleTr: Yeni filmden kısa bir klip gösterdiler.

meanings.en: in a careful way or with little space in between
meanings.exampleEn: The teacher watched the students closely during the exam.
meanings.exampleTr: Öğretmen sınav sırasında öğrencileri yakından izledi.

meanings.en: a hard black substance dug from the ground and burned for energy
meanings.exampleEn: In the past, many homes were heated with coal.
meanings.exampleTr: Geçmişte birçok ev kömürle ısıtılırdı.

meanings.en: located near or relating to the coast
meanings.exampleEn: They spent the summer in a small coastal town.
meanings.exampleTr: Yazı küçük bir kıyı kasabasında geçirdiler.

meanings.en: a large sea fish that is commonly used as food
meanings.exampleEn: We ordered cod and chips at the restaurant.
meanings.exampleTr: Restoranda morina balığı ve patates kızartması sipariş ettik.

meanings.en: a box in which a dead person is buried or cremated
meanings.exampleEn: The coffin was carried slowly into the church.
meanings.exampleTr: Tabut yavaşça kiliseye taşındı.

meanings.en: the part of a shirt or coat that fits around the neck
meanings.exampleEn: He turned up his collar to keep out the cold wind.
meanings.exampleTr: Soğuk rüzgârı engellemek için yakasını kaldırdı.

meanings.en: a journalist who writes a regular article in a newspaper
meanings.exampleEn: She works as a columnist for a national newspaper.
meanings.exampleTr: Ulusal bir gazetede köşe yazarı olarak çalışıyor.

meanings.en: a mixture of two or more different things
meanings.exampleEn: The dish is a delicious combination of sweet and sour flavours.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu yemek tatlı ve ekşi lezzetlerin lezzetli bir birleşimidir.

meanings.en: to join two or more things together
meanings.exampleEn: You can combine these two ingredients to make the sauce.
meanings.exampleTr: Sosu yapmak için bu iki malzemeyi birleştirebilirsin.

meanings.en: a performer whose job is to make people laugh
meanings.exampleEn: The comedian told jokes that made everyone laugh.
meanings.exampleTr: Komedyen herkesi güldüren şakalar yaptı.

meanings.en: a film, play or show that is funny and entertaining
meanings.exampleEn: We watched a comedy that made us laugh all evening.
meanings.exampleTr: Bütün akşam bizi güldüren bir komedi izledik.

meanings.en: an object in space that has a long bright tail
meanings.exampleEn: People gathered at night to watch the bright comet.
meanings.exampleTr: İnsanlar parlak kuyruklu yıldızı izlemek için gece toplandılar.

meanings.en: a pleasant feeling of being relaxed and free from pain
meanings.exampleEn: The new chair gives great comfort to my back.
meanings.exampleTr: Yeni sandalye sırtıma büyük bir rahatlık veriyor.

meanings.en: the punctuation mark ( , ) used to separate parts of a sentence
meanings.exampleEn: You should put a comma after the first word in that list.
meanings.exampleTr: O listedeki ilk kelimeden sonra bir virgül koymalısın.

meanings.en: an order given to a person, animal or computer
meanings.exampleEn: The soldiers obeyed the general's command immediately.
meanings.exampleTr: Askerler generalin emrine hemen uydular.

meanings.en: something you say or write to express an opinion
meanings.exampleEn: She made a helpful comment about my essay.
meanings.exampleTr: Denemem hakkında yararlı bir yorum yaptı.

meanings.en: relating to business and the buying and selling of goods
meanings.exampleEn: The film was a big commercial success around the world.
meanings.exampleTr: Film dünya genelinde büyük bir ticari başarı elde etti.

meanings.en: to do something wrong, or to promise to do something
meanings.exampleEn: He would never commit a crime against another person.
meanings.exampleTr: Başka bir kişiye karşı asla bir suç işlemezdi.

meanings.en: the ability to make good judgements in practical situations
meanings.exampleEn: Use your common sense and don't go out in the storm.
meanings.exampleTr: Sağduyunu kullan ve fırtınada dışarı çıkma.

meanings.en: in a way that happens often or is usual
meanings.exampleEn: This plant is commonly found in tropical countries.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu bitki tropikal ülkelerde yaygın olarak bulunur.

meanings.en: a person or animal that spends time with you
meanings.exampleEn: The dog was a loyal companion during her long journey.
meanings.exampleTr: Köpek, uzun yolculuğu boyunca sadık bir yoldaştı.

meanings.en: the act of examining how things are similar or different
meanings.exampleEn: A comparison of the two phones shows clear differences.
meanings.exampleTr: İki telefonun karşılaştırması açık farklılıklar gösteriyor.
